Ippudu meeru adigina main features gurinchi detailed ga cheptanu:

1. Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB):
Ee feature chala life-saving. AEB work chestundi ante, if the system detects that there's an imminent collision with something ahead – like another car or pedestrian – and the driver fails to react fast enough, then AEB automatically applies the brakes for you. 2. Lane Departure Warning (LDW):
Idi driver distraction ni reduce cheyadaniki help chestundi. LDW basically watches the lane markings on the road using cameras. If the truck starts drifting out of its designated lane without the turn signal being activated, this system gives a warning—usually an audible sound or a visual alert on the dashboard. 3. Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC):
Ee one comfort and safety both ni provide chestundi. Regular cruise control oka speed maintain chestundi. But ACC smarter ga undi. It maintains your set speed, but also keeps a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you. If the vehicle ahead slows down, ACC automatically reduces your speed; when it speeds up, it accelerates back to your set speed.

These features how they increase road safety:

Overall, these ADAS features act as a co-pilot for the driver. They monitor things humans might miss due to fatigue, distraction, or poor visibility.
